notes:
Account background: mid-stage startup building an IDE-embedded copilot for enterprise dev teams.

Key ask: predictable throughput for peak developer hours (team uses 9am-6pm PST heavily), low-latency streaming for token-by-token completion, and ability to pin specific model versions per release train.

From CTO Jordan Lee: "We need dev experience to feel native — sub-50ms completions for single-line suggestions, p99 under 300ms for full-line completions. Predictable monthly bill is a must so we can commit to a monthly subscription for dedicated capacity."

Security: heavy emphasis on KMS integration and audit trails. They will not accept shared multitenant KV cache unless encrypted with customer-managed keys. SOC2 in place; ISO interest. SSO via SAML required.

Commercial: preferred committed capacity with burst policy for night/weekend spikes. Interested in dedicated GPU pools with autoscale thresholds and explicit burst pricing. Wants a pricing example tied to 4TB token-month peak vs sustained.

POC notes: initial demo showed streaming latency at p50 ~32ms, p95 ~180ms on 4k context with small model variant. SE Liam to tune batching and KV prefix caching next run. Customer expects a second demo to validate model pinning API (ability to lock model v1.2.3 per workspace).

Sales shorthand / CRM fragments:
- AE Maya: validated use-case & budget band.
- PM Jordan: cares about version pinning and rollback safety.
- Eng lead Priya: wants test harness to run perf across 200 concurrent editors.

Open items: security questionnaire outstanding items (KMS key rotation policy), legal want SLA wording on p99, need realistic cost projection for 300 devs.

Quoted ask: "If Redwood can guarantee predictable throughput during our 9–18 PST window and give a clear burst model, we'll move to a 12-month reserved capacity contract."
